name: Cleopatra
role: Queen and pharaoh of Ptolemaic Egypt (51-30 BC)
summary: Cleopatra VII ruled Egypt as a hereditary Hellenistic monarch with divine status, presenting herself as the goddess Isis. Her recorded policy aims were keeping her throne and kingdom and passing it to her children, through alliances with Caesar and then Antony, and she regained former Ptolemaic territories. Most modern political questions are anachronistic for her, so few positions are recorded.
